segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the balm is rich, nourishing, and soothing, with some specifically noting relief from winter dryness.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with dry, sensitive skin says it's gentle and soothing as it cleans, and another notes it can be used around the eyes without irritation.
segments.mature: A few reviewers caution that the balm requires some tugging or rubbing to spread, which they say should be minimized on older, thinner, less elastic skin; one limits her washing frequency accordingly but remains a loyal user.

concerns.dehydration: An overwhelming number of reviewers, including several with dry skin, report the balm leaves their skin soft, nourished, and hydrated rather than tight or stripped, some noting it specifically helps with winter dryness.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer says the balm made her break out all over her face and left a filmy residue that required two additional cleansers to remove.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer says the balm felt oily and left a greasy film requiring extra cleansers to remove; several others, by contrast, say it specifically does not feel oily, unlike other cleansing balms they have tried.
concerns.redness: One reviewer says it stung and blurred her eyes when removing eye makeup, while another says she can use it around her eyes without any irritation.
concerns.aging: A few reviewers caution that the balm requires some tugging or rubbing to spread, which they say should be minimized on older, thinner, less elastic skin.

aspects.libelle: A little goes a long way
Can double as a hydrating mask

extraits.texte: Really oily and gross. Made me break out all over my face. Doesn't even cleanse. I had to use two more cleansers just to get out the film it leaves behind off my skin. I don't know why everybody loves this product. Customer service is ridiculous. Have to pay the return fee to return the product, and I don't even know if they will refund me. It's not worth buying from this company again.

extraits.titre: Needed too much pressure to spread
extraits.texte: Received a sample as a gift with purchase. While effective and gentle, I had to tug a bit on the skin to spread it on my face and work it into the skin, which might be ok if you're under 18, but should be avoided as an adult. No thanks!

I had to try this because of all the hype, even with it being so expensive. With the holiday discount, I gave it a shot. It's ok, it's definitely thick but doesn't have a great slip so I feel I'm rubbing my face too much and I avoid doing that to my aging skin. It cleans well, but felt it sting and blur my eyes when trying to take off my eye make-up. I think there's others out there that are less expensive for me to try before I commit to paying this much for this product.
Love this cleansing balm. It is gentle on my dry sensitive skin. It soothes as it cleans my face.
Best facial cleanser I have ever used. Love that you can use it on your eyes without any irritation. You only need a small amount to apply to entire face and it literally melts all the makeup away.

I purchased a holiday set because it was a good way to see what the buzz is all about. This is my first step in a double-cleanse routine. It did a fine job removing my non-waterproof makeup, but IMO it's not any better than some of the other, much less expensive brands out there. I have no problem spending money on luxury products if they're a game-changer, but for me, it is not. Any, I would think any skin care/moisturizing benefits that it may have would be washed away when I do my second wash. The black-cherry scent is strong and smells like a cheap candle.

Held off on this for a long time due to the price point. Snagged two during the BOGO minis and OMG - the thousands of 5 star reviews did not lie. It does not feel "oily" at all (this was my problem with most other brands). You only need about a dime-sized dollop to take off an entire face of makeup (this is very generous - you can totally use less). It feels extremely luxurious and the scent is subtle and calming. I am absolutely thrilled with this purchase and can't wait to try the other scents!!
